bio.text: Brandon Castro is the Republican candidate for New York State Assembly District 30 in Queens in the November 3, 2026 general election; the open seat's Democratic nominee is Patrick Martinez.

Ballotpedia, citing information he submitted in October 2024, says Castro was born in New York City, graduated from Queens Technical High School and earned a bachelor's degree from CUNY Queens College in 2023; in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey he described himself as a lifelong Queens resident and Queens College graduate.
He was also the Republican candidate for the same Assembly seat in 2024, when Steven Raga won re-election.
